_source: Scouting (decided Oct 7: the Scouting Centre level sets how much you see in the market and about your next opponent; the top level shows personality and an approximate potential, never everything; scouts have their own rating and a contract price only, a task (region, position, age) and write reports whose quality depends only on their rating; the market is searchable but limited to what your scouting covers; archetypes are never shown). Numbers proposed Oct 9 night, accepted by Carlos Oct 10.
_coverageNote: Market coverage by Scouting Centre working level: 1 = your league, 2 = your country, 4 = your confederation, 6 = every league, 8 = everyone (cup-only countries too). Players in your scouts' reports are visible for 2 seasons wherever they are.
_detailNote: How exact you see other clubs' players, by Scouting Centre working level: attributes and rating as a range of +/- N (index = level 1..10); potential as a range from level 7 (+/- 10, 8, 6, 4), never exact; personality shown from level 9. Your own players: exact attributes and rating; personality after a full season at the club or from level 5; potential by the same level rule.
_opponentNote: Next-opponent report from Scouting Centre level 3: their formation and best player.
_scoutNote: Scouts: up to 5 per club, rating 20-95, contract 1-4 seasons at the coaches' price formula (coaches.json). Each week a scout files 0-2 reports on players matching his task; better scouts spot more talent (they lean toward high-potential players) and are more accurate: range +/- (100 - rating) / 8 for rating and potential; scouts rated 70+ also reveal the personality. A report on a player 19 or younger estimated at 80+ potential is a wonderkid. A free pool of 80 scouts; AI clubs don't use scouts (the AI market already sees the whole world).
